flags.message: Snapshot 2026-11-26.json carries an inherited pre-docketing conference distribution ('Sep 16 2026: DISTRIBUTED for Conference of 10/9/2026' -> 'Oct 13 2026: Motion Granted') from linked miscellaneous sealing motion 26M23 before No. 26-502 was docketed on October 15, 2026. As a result, context.json freezes distribution_count=2 and band='elevated' even though the November 24, 2026 distribution (for the December 11, 2026 Conference) is the cert petition's first distribution and arrives on waivers from both respondents.
